findings.section_ref: Header metadata (lines 6-9) and Cross-Domain Interpretation and Scope Discipline (lines 166-169)
findings.claim: The manuscript date is out of sync with the release artifacts it cites: the front matter says 2026-04-21, but the Practical Utility Atlas referenced as part of the same Core 1.3 package is timestamped 2026-04-22T09:23:17Z in the canonical metadata.
findings.evidence: Line 8 lists "Release date: 2026-04-21". The body then points readers to the Practical Utility and Model Comparison Atlas as current release material, but the atlas metadata timestamp is 2026-04-22T09:23:17Z.
findings.required_action: LLM minor advisory only. Deterministic reviewers, hard-build checks, and LLM BLOCKER/MAJOR findings remain release-blocking; this observation is tracked for later editorial polish but does not block release acceptance.
